questions.subject: Hausa (L1)
questions.learningObjective: Interpret evidence, purpose and passage type in an original Hausa text about environmental awareness.
questions.prompt: Wace shaida ce ta nuna cewa toshewar magudanar ruwa ta taimaka wajen taruwar ruwan?
questions.passage: Bayan ruwan sama, ruwa ya tsaya a gaban makarantar unguwa. Wasu mutane sun ce ruwan saman ne kaɗai ya jawo matsalar. Amma ɗalibai sun lura cewa ledoji da ganyaye sun toshe magudanar ruwa. Da aka kwashe su, ruwan ya fara gudana. Kwamitin unguwa ya tanadi wurin zubar da shara, ya kuma tsara duba magudanar ruwa kafin lokacin damina. Ba su jira ruwa ya sake taruwa ba.
options: An tsara duba magudanar ruwa kafin damina.
Ruwan ya fara gudana bayan an kwashe ledoji da ganyaye.
Wasu mutane sun yi magana a kan ruwan sama.
Makarantar tana cikin unguwa.
questions.answer: Ruwan ya fara gudana bayan an kwashe ledoji da ganyaye.
questions.explanation: Bayan an cire abubuwan da suka toshe magudanar, ruwan ya gudana. Wannan ita ce shaida kai tsaye.

questions.prompt: Wane mataki ne kwamitin ya ɗauka domin rage sake faruwar matsalar?

options: Jiran wani ruwan sama kafin ɗaukar mataki.
Mayar da ledojin cikin magudanar ruwa.
Rufe makarantar a duk lokacin damina.
Tanadin wurin zubar da shara da duba magudanar ruwa.
questions.answer: Tanadin wurin zubar da shara da duba magudanar ruwa.
questions.explanation: Kwamitin ya tanadi wurin shara, ya kuma tsara dubawa kafin damina. Waɗannan matakai ne na rigakafi.

questions.subject: Hausa (L1)

questions.prompt: A cikin jawabin, mene ne ma’anar cewa abubuwa sun “toshe” magudanar ruwa?
questions.passage: Bayan ruwan sama, ruwa ya tsaya a gaban makarantar unguwa. Wasu mutane sun ce ruwan saman ne kaɗai ya jawo matsalar. Amma ɗalibai sun lura cewa ledoji da ganyaye sun toshe magudanar ruwa. Da aka kwashe su, ruwan ya fara gudana. Kwamitin unguwa ya tanadi wurin zubar da shara, ya kuma tsara duba magudanar ruwa kafin lokacin damina. Ba su jira ruwa ya sake taruwa ba.
options: Sun hana ruwa wucewa yadda ya kamata.
Sun ƙara zurfin magudanar ruwa.
Sun sa ruwa ya ƙafe nan da nan.
Sun canza ruwan zuwa shara.
questions.answer: Sun hana ruwa wucewa yadda ya kamata.
questions.explanation: Ledoji da ganyaye sun hana ruwan gudana; da aka cire su sai ya fara wucewa.

questions.prompt: Wane nau’in jawabi ne wannan ya fi wakilta?

questions.subject: Hausa (L1)
questions.learningObjective: Interpret details, inference and passage type in an original Hausa text about computer records.
questions.prompt: Me ya sa ɗaliban suka shigar da bayanan cikin kwamfuta?
questions.passage: Ɗaliban aji uku suna rubuta yawan buhunan takin da aka kai lambun makaranta a littafi. Daga baya suka shigar da bayanan cikin kwamfuta domin su samu jimilla cikin sauƙi. Da suka kwatanta jimillar kwamfuta da ta littafi, sun ga ba su yi daidai ba. Amina ta gano cewa an bar bayanan ranar Talata ba a shigar ba. Ta gyara wannan kuskure, sannan wani ɗalibi ya sake dubawa. Sun fahimci cewa kwamfuta tana taimaka wa aiki, amma sai an shigar da bayanai daidai.
options: Domin su daina amfani da taki a lambu.
Domin su ɓoye bayanan ranar Talata.
Domin su samu jimilla cikin sauƙi.
Domin su canza sunan lambun.
questions.answer: Domin su samu jimilla cikin sauƙi.
questions.explanation: Jawabin ya bayyana cewa an yi amfani da kwamfuta domin samun jimilla cikin sauƙi.

questions.prompt: Mene ne ya sa jimillar kwamfuta ta bambanta da ta littafi?
questions.passage: Ɗaliban aji uku suna rubuta yawan buhunan takin da aka kai lambun makaranta a littafi. Daga baya suka shigar da bayanan cikin kwamfuta domin su samu jimilla cikin sauƙi. Da suka kwatanta jimillar kwamfuta da ta littafi, sun ga ba su yi daidai ba. Amina ta gano cewa an bar bayanan ranar Talata ba a shigar ba. Ta gyara wannan kuskure, sannan wani ɗalibi ya sake dubawa. Sun fahimci cewa kwamfuta tana taimaka wa aiki, amma sai an shigar da bayanai daidai.
options: An shigar da bayanan kowace rana sau biyu.
An bar bayanan ranar Talata ba a shigar ba.
An rasa littafin da aka rubuta bayanai a ciki.
Ba a taɓa kai taki lambun ba.
questions.answer: An bar bayanan ranar Talata ba a shigar ba.
questions.explanation: Amina ta gano cewa bayanan Talata ne ba a shigar ba; ba matsalar lissafin kwamfuta aka ambata ba.

questions.prompt: Wace fahimta ce jawabin yake goyon baya game da amfani da kwamfuta?

Sun fahimci cewa kwamfuta tana taimaka wa aiki, amma sai an shigar da bayanai daidai.

Dubawa ba ta da muhimmanci bayan shigar da bayanai.

questions.explanation: An samu kuskure saboda bayanan da aka bari. Gyara da sake dubawa suna taimakawa tabbatar da ingancin sakamako.

questions.prompt: Wane batu ne ya sa wannan jawabi ya dace da nau’in jawabi kan fasaha?
questions.passage: Ɗaliban aji uku suna rubuta yawan buhunan takin da aka kai lambun makaranta a littafi. Daga baya suka shigar da bayanan cikin kwamfuta domin su samu jimilla cikin sauƙi.
